senses.gloss:
urú, f. urvī́, a. (prop. encompassing, and
so, like Eng. capacious) extensive, wide,
great; as n. (like Ger. das Weite) the distance.
 [√1vṛ, ‘encompass,’ 1178a: cf.
εὐρύ-ς, ‘wide.’]

ūrú, m. thigh. [prob. ‘the thick’ of the
leg, from urú.]

uru-vyácas, a. having wide embrace,
wide extending. [acct, 1298b.]

√uruṣya (uruṣyáti). to distance, i. e.
escape; put another in the distance, i. e.
save. [urú, ‘the distance,’ 1061^2.]

urū-ṇasá, a. having broad snouts. [urú
(247) + nás, 193, 1315c: acct, 1298b.]
